info.title: Mesa virtual ESP8266 HTTP example
info.description: Simulator-only HTTP contract. No socket, internet, hardware or firmware execution. These example endpoints exist only after explicit configuration of the selected device. No authentication in this isolated model.

servers.description: Example allocated virtual address; each connected device has a distinct deterministic address.

x-mesa-routing.target: Caller supplies expected componentId and absolute HTTP URL. Address must match that device, never silently reroute.
x-mesa-routing.configuration: Exact method/path configurable per device, at most 20 routes, statuses 200..599. GPIO actions allowed on 2xx only.
x-mesa-routing.constraints: No credentials, query, fragment, custom port, scripts or external HTTP. Request body is bounded text, never executed.
x-mesa-routing.lifecycle: Connect/disconnect synchronous. GPIO actions require running simulation. Stop/reset clears sessions/history/overrides; disconnect retains GPIO state. History bounded to 50 entries per device.

get.description: Available only when the user installs/configures this example. Success updates output GPIO on the explicitly targeted ESP8266 and evaluates the electrical circuit; it does not guarantee LED illumination.

404.description: Device or configured route not found

405.description: Configured path exists with a different method

409.description: Target address mismatch or simulation is not running

503.description: Device disconnected or address pool exhausted
